title: Customer support agent with approved refunds
summary: Routes support requests, answers from a policy knowledge base, and issues refunds only after a person approves.

components.role: classify the request as order help, policy question or refund
components.name: Request router

components.role: write the customer answer from retrieved policy text
components.name: Answer writer

components.role: look up orders and issue refunds
components.name: Orders API

components.role: a support lead approves every refund
components.name: Refund approval

guardrails.description: Redacts card numbers and national ids before any model sees the text.
Every order lookup and refund is logged with the request id and the approver.

failure_modes.description: A refund request is routed to the plain-answer path and the customer is told it is done.
An answer quotes a policy that has since changed.
Personal data reaches a model or a log.

eval_plan.method: 200 labelled tickets, rerun on every prompt change
replay of refund requests; no refund without an approval record

deployment.notes: The gate is a queue in the support tool, not a model.
